filing_office: Maine Secretary of State, Division of Corporations, UCC and Commissions
filing_fee_notes: Base domestic Certificate of Formation fee; annual reporting is separate.
registered_agent_rules: Designate a consenting commercial or noncommercial registered agent. The noncommercial agent's form requires a physical location, not a P.O. box.
standard_processing_time: The live Secretary of State forms page currently posts 2-7 business days for corporate filings; this is a changing queue estimate.
annual_report_due: January 1 through June 1 each year, beginning the calendar year after formation.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Maine Department of Labor, Bureau of Unemployment Compensation
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Formation and designate a consenting registered agent. File annual reports starting the following year.
common_mistake: Assuming the state will mail an annual-report reminder.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Direct online formation and name-search URLs, expedite options, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed through the permitted agency sources and are null. Older indexed forms-page text showed 40-55 business days; the live page shows 2-7. Annual-report URL is an official gateway.
